name: Lucidity
source:
After countless of sleepless nights, you finally able to fall asleep with the work of new sleeping pills! You're then taken to be beautiful world of dreams where you meet your new friend Tulip! Will you stay with her in the dream? Forever?

Or will you leave the dream and have calm nights?

[From [url=https://donutworks.itch.io/lucidity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过无数个不眠之夜，在新型安眠药的作用下，你终于可以入睡了！然后你会被带到美丽的梦想世界，在那里你会遇到你的新朋友郁金香！你会在梦里陪着她吗？永远？

或者你会离开梦境并度过平静的夜晚吗？

[来自[url=https://donutworks.itch.io/lucidity]itch.io[/url]]
